overview.title: Discover Cloud Empowers Your Engineering Teams
body: Discover Cloud is a powerful solution designed to measure, benchmark, and sustain the highest quality code in your applications. It enables your teams to establish meaningful benchmarks that assess performance at every stage, ensuring that only top-tier code moves forward.

Beyond identifying the parameters responsible for breaches, Discover Cloud provides actionable insights to help your teams effectively address and resolve specific issues. Additionally, Discover Cloud features an automated Scheduler for testing both single and bulk transactions, allowing you to evaluate the responsiveness, robustness, and scalability of your application.
Stay ahead of the curve with Discover Cloud's subscription feature, keeping your teams informed and up-to-date.

process.title: Flexible Process, Tailored for Your Success
process.lead: Whether you are dealing with a messed-up org or a well-oiled org. Whether you are facing governance issues or technical challenges. Our CoE teams can help you overcome any hurdle effortlessly. Here’s how we do it:

steps.title: Evaluation
steps.text: The first step is an in-depth evaluation. We discuss your bottlenecks, requirements, and goals. Once our teams have a clear understanding, we proceed to the engagement models.

steps.title: Engagement Models
steps.text: While most companies prefer a Hybrid Agile approach, we can tailor our approach based on the evaluation, selecting the best engagement model to suit your needs

steps.title: Prioritization
steps.text: Next, we set priorities for our think tanks, focusing on recurring issues such as governance, assets, or architecture. This ensures clear deliverables and a focused action plan.

steps.title: Set-up
steps.text: We begin by deploying a small team to address your initial bottlenecks. As your operations and challenges become clearer, we scale the team as needed to ensure optimal support.

steps.title: Maturity
steps.text: In this phase, our CoE teams start solving your problems through iterative processes. By deploying best practices, the right tools, assets, and frameworks, we offer quick and effective resolutions, helping you achieve more in less time.

services.title: Org Assessment
services.tagline: Unlock Your Salesforce Org's Full Potential with a Comprehensive Performance Assessment.
services.summary: Our expert “mechanics” have the tools and experience to get your Salesforce Org running like new.
intro: Over time, even the best Salesforce implementations can encounter performance issues due to factors like technical debt, outdated workflows, empty fields, large Data Volumes and the accumulation of undocumented changes over time. These issues can lead to slow page loads, incomplete records, and inefficient workflows.

overview.title: The Good News is that our expert “mechanics” have the tools and experience to get your Salesforce Org running like new.
body: Our Org Assessment engagement helps you streamline and optimize your org effortlessly.

steps.text: A quick health check is all it takes to get on the right track. Our expert teams assess your complete implementation, technical debts, and deployed technologies to identify gaps and areas for improvement

steps.title: The Three Angles
steps.text: We take your enterprise architecture, data architecture, and business vision into account, and create effective strategies to help you achieve your goals.

steps.title: Possible Resolutions
steps.text: Based on the initial assessment, we propose effective resolutions. You have the flexibility to adopt all or select a few that best suit your needs.

steps.title: Execution Plan
steps.text: We create a comprehensive roadmap, discussing scope and configuration. To ensure seamless business operations, we implement the lift and shift in phases.

items.a: Enabled Analytics is a hub of talented Salesforce experts dedicated to empowering your business. We provide service offerings and solutions for various Salesforce Clouds — consulting, implementation, and operational support & maintenance — and you can measure the results with our pre-built scorecards.

items.q: Which Salesforce products do you work with?
items.a: Our practice areas cover Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Account Engagement, Experience Cloud, CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Vlocity CPQ and Apttus CPQ), Salesforce Field Service and Data Cloud.

items.q: What engagement models do you offer?
items.a: Our engagement models include fixed price as well as time & material. You can partner up with us for your implementations or hire our experts, and scale up and down as per your needs. While most companies prefer a Hybrid Agile approach, we can tailor our approach based on an evaluation.

The CoE teams at Enabled Analytics are expert steering committees fluent in Salesforce. They are comprised of seasoned solution, technical, and design architects who bring together diverse skills, knowledge, assets, and tools to deliver tailored and effective solutions for your organization.

items.q: Can you help if our Salesforce org already exists?
items.a: Yes. Whether you're dealing with a well-established Salesforce org or starting fresh, our CoE teams offer guidance and support from day one. Our Org Assessment begins with a quick health check of your complete implementation, technical debts, and deployed technologies to identify gaps and areas for improvement.

items.q: How do your accelerators speed up implementation?
items.a: Our integration frameworks, pre-built data models, data migration templates, and apex utilities provide a solid foundation so you don't start from scratch. Our flagship assets and accelerators are designed to help you deploy at 3X speed and at up to 60% lower costs.

Discover Cloud is our product designed to measure, benchmark, and sustain the highest quality code in your applications. It includes performance tracking, log insights, an automated scheduler for single and bulk transaction testing, subscriptions and bulk data testing.
We are spread across three continents. Our listed offices are in Lewisville, Texas (USA), Hyderabad (India) and Singapore.
We have a 4.9 CSAT score, 100+ global clients, 500+ Salesforce certifications and 150+ projects.
Tell us about your project in brief and we’ll connect you to one of our Salesforce experts. You can use the contact form, call 214 402 3125 or email info@enabledanalytics.com.

sections.title: Privacy Notice
body: This privacy notice discloses the privacy practices for Enabled Analytics and our website. This privacy notice applies solely to information collected by this website, except where stated otherwise. It will notify you of the following:
list: How policy changes will be communicated.
How to address concerns over misuse of personal data.

sections.title: Information Collection, Use, and Sharing
body: We are the sole owners of the information collected on this site. We only have access to/collect information that you voluntarily give us via email or other direct contact from you. We will not sell or rent this information to anyone.

We will use your information to respond to you, regarding the reason you contacted us. We will not share your information with any third party outside of our organization, other than as necessary to fulfil your request.
Unless you ask us not to, we may contact you via email in the future to tell you about specials, new products or services, or changes to this privacy policy.

sections.title: Your Access to and Control Over Information
body: You may opt out of any future contacts from us at any time. You can do the following at any time by contacting us via the email address or phone number provided on our website:
list: See what data we have about you, if any.
Change/correct any data we have about you.
Have us delete any data we have about you.
Express any concern you have about our use of your data.

sections.title: Registration
body: In order to use this website, a user must first complete the registration form. During registration, a user is required to give certain information (such as name and email address). This information is used to contact you about the products/services on our site in which you have expressed interest. At your option, you may also provide demographic information (such as gender or age) about yourself, but it is not required.

sections.title: Sharing
body: We share aggregated demographic information with our partners. This is not linked to any personal information that can identify any individual person.

sections.title: Security
body: We take precautions to protect your information. When you submit sensitive information via the website, your information is protected both online and offline.

Wherever we collect sensitive information, that information is encrypted and transmitted to us in a secure way. You can verify this by looking for a closed lock icon in your web browser, or looking for “https” at the beginning of the address of the web page.

While we use encryption to protect sensitive information transmitted online, we also protect your information offline. Only employees who need the information to perform a specific job are granted access to personally identifiable information.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This website stores cookies on your computer. These cookies are used to improve your website experience and provide more personalized services to you, both on this website and through other media.
We won't track your information when you visit our site. But in order to comply with your preferences, we'll have to use just one tiny cookie so that you're not asked to make this choice again.

A cookie is a piece of data stored on a site visitor’s hard drive to help us improve your access to our site and identify repeat visitors to our site. Usage of a cookie is in no way linked to any personally identifiable information on our site.

sections.title: Links
body: This website contains links to other sites. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of such other sites. We encourage our users to be aware when they leave our site and to read the privacy statements of any other site that collects personally identifiable information.

sections.title: Contact
body: If you feel that we are not abiding by this privacy policy, you should contact us immediately via email at info@enabledanalytics.com.
